name: How does an AI SEO audit differ from a traditional SEO audit?

mainEntity.name: How does an AI SEO audit differ from a traditional SEO audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI SEO audit goes beyond traditional SEO by specifically addressing how artificial intelligence algorithms understand, process, and rank web content. While traditional audits focus on keywords, backlinks, and technical elements, AI SEO audits emphasize semantic understanding, entity recognition, user intent signals, and structured data crucial for AI-driven search. It ensures your content is optimized not just for search engines, but for AI's interpretation of quality and relevance.
acceptedAnswer.description: An AI SEO audit focuses on optimizing for AI algorithms' understanding of content and user intent, whereas traditional audits primarily address keywords and technical SEO.
